scope: Correct active/generated wording about two distinct registered overlap witnesses. Historical experiment receipts remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
incorrect_attribution: Some RBU31 and H31-E2 historical wording attributes universal 100% three-pixel footprint coverage to the r13 spacing-5 lattice.

corrected_facts.interpretation: The lattice's three-pixel halo covers 99.871327% of the allowed footprint. This is not universal 100% coverage of every possible candidate. Specific fixed artifacts can still have 100% of their dots within its halo; for example, each frozen MAGREST variant does.

This is the distinct full-support witness. Under the inherited positive-support interpretation it yields 100% forward overlap for every nonempty candidate in the allowed footprint. It is a continuous field, not a sparse dot raster; this conclusion is conditional on that recorded support definition.

decision: The unexempted overlap STOP remains in force. The fixed MAGREST variants individually exceed the 70% limit against the r13 lattice, and the separate GEMSDOE48 full-support witness is a universal blocker under the inherited finite-value > 0 semantics. Do not fit, place, emit, or package another TIFF under this stopped lane.
provenance_caveat: The source repositories and the 695-raster snapshot are owner-maintained mirrors, not organizer-authenticated registry or scoring evidence. One registered counterexample suffices for the project's literal stop; no exhaustive scan or organizer acceptance is claimed.
